prologue.title: 雨夜天台
prologue.narration: 新港雨幕下，38层天台霓虹反射。林夏手指紧贴发蓝接口，目光像刀子。
prologue.image: Rooftop at night. Characters: Lin Xia stands center, close-up three-quarter, hand on glowing wrist port; Raven perched shadowy at edge with long rifle, wide shot; neon rain backlight, high contrast.

prologue.title: 巷口埋伏
prologue.narration: 巷口汽雾，陈默靠墙藏影，目光死沉。三年前的债仍未结清。
prologue.image: Alley ambush. Characters: Chen Mo half-body, leaning against wall, revolver visible; Lin Xiaoyu emerging from shadow with camera; medium shot; low, cold streetlight illumination.

prologue.title: 董事会窗前
prologue.narration: 高楼之巅，顾衡在窗前把玩金袖扣，城市像棋盘任他摆弄。
prologue.image: Boardroom high-rise. Characters: Gu Heng full body by panoramic window, backlit, silver hair, white suit; Raven shown in small inset silhouette; wide establishing shot, cold interior light and city lights beyond.

root.question: 你要如何在天台完成交换？

segment.title: 硬碰硬
segment.narration: 林夏从口袋掏出星核，灯光把她脸切成两半。渡鸦缓步靠近，空气像要爆裂。
segment.image: Rooftop close-up. Characters: Lin Xia extends a blue data chip (Star Core) in hand; Raven steps forward, medium close shot, white beak mask foreground; tense tight framing, rain highlights metal.

node.question: 林夏把星核摆上天台，接下来？

segment.title: 交换开始
segment.narration: 霓虹映出寒光，林夏把蓝色芯片放在手掌，空气像被刀割。渡鸦缓步靠近，影子比人多。
segment.image: Lin Xia stands center rooftop, holding a glowing blue chip in palm; Raven approaches from shadowed edge with long rifle slung; wide shot, neon rain reflections, high-contrast rim lighting

node.question: 渡鸦接近中，林夏要怎样保证妹妹安全？

segment.title: 要口头保证
segment.narration: 林夏逼着渡鸦承诺，声音低沉如雨。渡鸦几乎不动，红镜片盯着她的手指。
segment.image: Close-up on Lin Xia's hand holding chip, Raven's red goggle reflected; tight medium shot, backlight from neon, rain streaks

node.question: 渡鸦答应条件后交付？

segment.title: 暂时交付
segment.narration: 林夏把星核递出去，手微抖。渡鸦接过，转身消失在雨幕。黎明前她收到妹妹安全的匿名位置，然而天穹的监控仍在城市上空盘旋，未来未知。
segment.image: Lin Xia hands chip to Raven; Raven turns away into rain; medium-long shot, rooftop edge, pale dawn light on horizon

segment.title: 承诺的代价
segment.narration: 渡鸦接过星核，口中低语一声命令。穹顶的无人机像蜘蛛般落下；林小雨的定位被迫曝光，林夏当场被捕，妹妹彻底卷入财团的实验名单，夜色中只有陈默无助的影子守望。
segment.image: Raven holding chip, background drones deploying; Lin Xia stunned, Chen Mo stepping forward; dramatic high-angle, cold blue light, rain

segment.title: 瞬间后悔
segment.narration: 林夏一念之差收回手，渡鸦瞬间扣动扳机，子弹擦肩。芯片掉落屋檐，滚向黑暗。选择让交易瞬间失败，后果未定。
segment.image: Chip slipping from Lin Xia's hand as Raven fires; extreme close-up on falling chip, muzzle flash; saturated neon rain

segment.title: 以命作抵
segment.narration: 林夏低声说出计划：以自己作底牌，换取妹妹撤离。天台上只有风与雨听她的赌注。
segment.image: Lin Xia stepping forward, offering chip like a pledge; Chen Mo tense behind wall, Raven motionless; medium shot, harsh neon rim light

node.question: 渡鸦接受这个交换吗？

segment.title: 换来一线
segment.narration: 渡鸦冷冷点头，星核从林夏掌心滑出。信息随后传到林小雨电话：去指定的废站。林夏被带走，她看着妹妹匆匆远去，心里既安心又破碎。城里多了一个暗角的代价。
segment.image: Raven escorting Lin Xia away; Lin Xiaoyu running toward distant light; rooftop long shot, rainy haze, warm light on girl

segment.title: 打破协议
segment.narration: 陈默突然现身，枪口对准渡鸦。混乱中子弹划破雨夜，渡鸦消失在烟雾。林小雨被一名下属护走，林夏趁乱逃离，但星核被破坏，证据可能永远丢失。
segment.image: Chen Mo firing from cover, Raven recoiling; Lin Xia running into stairwell holding ruined chip; dynamic diagonal composition, muzzle flashes, rain

segment.title: 迟疑
segment.narration: 林夏在最后一秒缩回话语，无法让自己成交换物。渡鸦冷笑，夜色变得更冷。错失的机会像血一样流在天台。
segment.image: Lin Xia stepping back, hands empty; Raven raising rifle; tight two-shot, rain on faces, stark contrast

segment.title: 公开证据
segment.narration: 林夏提出条件：把星核的镜像立即传向公开网络，否则不交。天台上的空气凝结成一场最后的赌注。
segment.image: Lin Xia holding chip toward small transmitter, Raven skeptical; close-medium shot, neon glints, rain-smeared glass

node.question: 能否成功把证据公开？

segment.title: 曝光
segment.narration: 星核镜像像流光一样被散布到城市网络。黎明时分，天穹的工程遭到质疑，顾衡的笑容在新闻里僵硬。林小雨安全脱身，林夏和陈默躲进城市的阴影，等待反扑的时机。
segment.image: Screens across city lighting up with same blue data image; Lin Xia and Chen Mo watching from rooftop; wide panoramic shot, dawn breaking, data glow

segment.title: 被吞噬的真相
segment.narration: 传输被穹顶的防火墙瞬间切断，镜像成片段散落在黑市。顾衡微笑，城市回到无眠的常态。林夏逃过一劫，但她知道，真正的战斗才刚开始。
segment.image: Raven watching a failed uplink on a handheld device; close-up on cut transmission bars; rooftop under heavy rain, dim emergency lights

segment.title: 撤回
segment.narration: 在最后一刻林夏删除了要公开的镜像，决定保留唯一的证据。她的选择让真相沉在水下，但也保护了妹妹的踪迹。
segment.image: Lin Xia's fingers gliding over a small device, deleting files; tight focus on screen wipe, rain blur in background

segment.title: 拒绝
segment.narration: 林夏沉默，星核仍在口袋里。渡鸦的步伐停住，天台的雨声忽然大了几分。
segment.image: Lin Xia standing defiant with hands in pockets; Raven crouched, rifle pointed but not fired; medium shot, neon-lit rain

node.question: 拒绝后对方先动手？如何应对？

segment.title: 陈默出手
segment.narration: 陈默从阴影冲出，一记翻滚试图摁住渡鸦的武器。雨水和烟雾混成一团暴力的序曲。
segment.image: Chen Mo lunging from cover to tackle Raven; dynamic action mid-shot, rain spray, motion blur

node.question: 战斗中能否保住星核？

segment.title: 夺回
segment.narration: 星核在混乱中被陈默抢到，林夏和他翻下天台楼梯消失。黎明前他们将证据交给地下记者，城市的夜里多了一束不灭的光。
segment.image: Chen Mo holding chip high as they descend fire escape; medium-long shot, stairwell lit by emergency lights, rain blurring neon

segment.title: 落空
segment.narration: 渡鸦冷静反击，星核被夺走并迅速封存。陈默重伤，林夏拖着他逃离，但夜色里她听到妹妹的求救声——位置被曝光了。
segment.image: Raven holding chip with gloved hand, Chen Mo collapsed, Lin Xia cradling him; close-up, rain on faces, neon reflections

segment.title: 诱敌
segment.narration: 林夏冷笑，像在下棋。她故意拒绝，以诱使渡鸦露出身份与通讯轨迹——这是她早已布好的陷阱。

dialogue.speaker: Lin Xia
dialogue.text: 你们不过是有壳的乌鸦。

segment.image: Lin Xia with subtle smirk, fingers tapping wrist interface; Raven frowning, step forward; medium shot, neon backlight

node.question: 诱捕成功，接下来怎么处理渡鸦？

segment.title: 活捉
segment.narration: 渡鸦被捕后，陈默把他押到一处秘密房间。审问揭出更多天穹实验的线索，顾衡的阴谋浮出水面，林小雨也因此获得撤离机会。
segment.image: Raven tied in dim interrogation room; Chen Mo leaning over, Lin Xia watching; low-key lighting, single overhead lamp

segment.title: 放走
segment.narration: 他们故意放走渡鸦，借此引出顾衡的手下。代价是短暂的失控，但林夏得到了通往顾衡核心防线的必经路径——一场更大的夜战在等待。
segment.image: Raven disappearing into rain after staged escape; Lin Xia and Chen Mo watching from shadow; wide shot, city skyline, ominous clouds

segment.title: 误导
segment.narration: 林夏通过接口发出虚假讯号，制造援兵到达的假象。渡鸦短暂犹豫，城市的灯光像被拉扯成一张网。
segment.image: Lin Xia tapping blue wrist interface, holographic map flickering; Raven scanning skyline; medium close, blue glow

node.question: 假象能否成功吓退渡鸦？

segment.title: 退却
segment.narration: 渡鸦退到阴影中，林夏趁机带着妹妹的线索撤离。虽未带走星核，但她保住了最重要的东西：林小雨的生命和继续战斗的机会。
segment.image: Lin Xia guiding Lin Xiaoyu down stairwell while Raven watches from rooftop ledge; medium-long shot, wet steps, neon reflections

segment.title: 识破
segment.narration: 天穹识别出虚假信号并回放了真实轨迹，渡鸦马上将位置报告回去。顾衡派出直升机，天台被 vollständig 封锁，林夏和林小雨被迫分开逃生。
segment.image: Helicopter spotlight sweeping rooftop; Lin Xia diving behind parapet as Lin Xiaoyu runs opposite way; dramatic high-contrast lighting

outcomes.label: 暗中转卖
outcomes.hint: 将芯片偷偷拷贝再卖给对手

segment.title: 暗卖
segment.narration: 林夏做出惊人一举：当面交出的是复制品，原件仍握在她掌心。渡鸦的脚步不知不觉被牵引。
segment.image: Lin Xia sliding a small glowing duplicate to Raven while concealing original under coat; medium close, rain-slick neon, tense eye contact

node.question: 如何处置真芯片？

segment.title: 卖给地下
segment.narration: 林夏计划把真芯片卖给地下反抗组织，用换来的资源护送妹妹远走高飞。交易在雨中游走，城市的阴暗角落有新主张。
segment.image: Lin Xia meeting shadowy buyer in alley off rooftop, chip exchanged under hood; low-angle shot, wet cobblestones, dim orange lamp

node.question: 交易是否安全？

segment.title: 换自由
segment.narration: 地下组织付清代价并提供假身份与撤离路线。黎明时林小雨远走国外，林夏带着报酬和未竟的仇走向更长的战线——她失去了直接曝光的机会，但保住了最重要的人。
segment.image: Lin Xia watching Lin Xiaoyu board a van under tarp, dawn light; medium-long shot, van pulling away, rain-slick street

segment.title: 出卖
segment.narration: 所谓买家是穹顶的线人，交换瞬间变成包围。林夏被逼到绝路，星核被没收，林小雨被迫成为实验的候选人。顾衡在高楼之上满足地微笑。
segment.image: Armed agents surrounding alley, Lin Xia cornered with chip confiscated; tight composition, flashlights, rain

outcomes.label: 悔棋：销毁芯片
outcomes.hint: 放弃金钱选择毁灭证据

segment.title: 销毁
segment.narration: 林夏瞬间决定毁掉星核，宁可失去筹码也不愿让证据落入任何掌控者手中。芯片化为灰烬，信息随烟散去，天穹的秘密再次被锁进黑暗。
segment.image: Chip burning between Lin Xia's gloved fingers, tiny sparks flying; extreme close-up, orange embers against rain

outcomes.label: 保留转交顾衡
outcomes.hint: 将秘密亲交对手以换更大利益

segment.title: 亲交对手
segment.narration: 林夏决定亲自把真芯片交给顾衡，以博取更有利的位置或更大保护。这是极端的赌注：以敌为友或被吞噬。
segment.image: Lin Xia entering a glass elevator leading to Gu Heng's penthouse, chip hidden; vertical composition, neon reflections, luxurious interior

node.question: 顾衡会如何回应这份诚意？

segment.title: 同盟成立
segment.narration: 顾衡接受了芯片的真件，承诺给林夏与妹妹一张‘免死牌’作为交换。表面上的安宁背后，是更深的控制契约。林夏带着复杂的胜利与沉重的代价回到夜色中。
segment.image: Gu Heng and Lin Xia across a glass table, chip placed between them; low-key luxury lighting, reflections

segment.title: 收编
segment.narration: 顾衡当场将林夏招安，星核被封存进穹顶的核心。林夏被迫成为财团信息网的一颗棋子，妹妹得到安全却换来姐姐彻底的失自由。
segment.image: Lin Xia escorted into a sterile corporate elevator by suited agents; close-medium shot, clinical white light, chrome surfaces

segment.title: 密谋
segment.narration: 在电梯门半开的一刻，林夏暗中与陈默交换了眼神——他们策划把芯片私下再卖给地下，表面上被收编，暗中保留反扑的筹码。未来的路更危险，但希望仍在。
segment.image: Half-open elevator door, Lin Xia's silhouette whispering to Chen Mo in reflection; close detail, split light

outcomes.label: 藏匿等待时机
outcomes.hint: 暂时保留，等待更好机会

segment.title: 潜藏
segment.narration: 林夏不交也不卖，她将真芯片藏入城市的某处，只留下引渡的副本。夜色成为她的盟友，时间是她的赌注。
segment.image: Lin Xia depositing chip into a hidden locker under a neon sign; medium close, rain, subtle alley details

node.question: 藏匿成功后下一步？

segment.title: 潜伏
segment.narration: 星核被封存在城市一个不起眼的角落。林夏与陈默过上游走于阴影的生活，等待时机揭露穹顶。生活被推向长期的对抗，但真相终有一天会被拉进光里。
segment.image: Lin Xia and Chen Mo in a cramped safehouse, maps on walls, hidden locker with chip; interior low-light, planning mood

segment.title: 发现
segment.narration: 穹顶的长臂追踪到藏匿处。无人机摧毁那块角落，星核与希望化为碎片。林小雨被定位，林夏的每一步下一秒都可能是死亡。
segment.image: Drone beam cutting through alley, hidden locker exploding; chaotic wide shot, debris, rain

outcomes.label: 悔棋：公开线索地点
outcomes.hint: 为了保护妹妹公开地址

segment.title: 公开地点
segment.narration: 林夏突然把藏匿地点通过匿名信告诉一个记者，希望以此换取妹妹的安全。信息被放出后，局势复杂化，但林小雨得以被官方列为特别保护对象。
segment.image: Anonymous envelope delivered to newsroom, headline printing; close-up on hands passing envelope, rain-splattered window

twist.label: 陈默的秘密身份
twist.hint: 他并非完全站在林夏这一边

segment.title: 旧债重现
segment.narration: 在交易最关键的瞬间，陈默的昔日同僚出现，他的旧身份被揭示：他曾为穹顶秘密情报部工作。这一秘密会改变所有抉择的代价。
segment.image: Chen Mo's shadow split between Lin Xia and Raven; close-medium shot, flashback lighting, rain streaks double-exposed

segment.title: 指间戏法
segment.narration: 林夏眼角一瞥，芯片在袖中与假货互换。渡鸦的视线像雷达扫过却错过了节拍。
segment.image: Rooftop mid-shot. Characters: Lin Xia performing sleight with sleeve, close-up on hands swapping chips; Raven slightly blurred in background aiming rifle, over-the-shoulder composition, harsh neon rim light.

node.question: 林夏暗中换芯片后，下一刻怎么办？

outcomes.label: 假装交付
outcomes.hint: 把假货递上去，保留星核

segment.title: 递与不递
segment.narration: 林夏面无表情，把袖中硬块推向交易桌，雨声像锤。天空的霓虹把她侧脸切成刀锋。
segment.image: Lin Xia hands a sleeve-wrapped object forward; Raven stands opposite with long cloak, medium shot; neon reflections, wet rooftop, hard side light

node.question: 渡鸦要验货，林夏怎么办？

segment.title: 光牵制视线
segment.narration: 林夏袖口微闪，发蓝接口投出冷光，渡鸦的视线被拉扯，半秒差距如生死线。
segment.image: Lin Xia flicks her glowing wrist; Raven's red goggle turns toward the light, close-up on wrist and eye, stark rim lighting

node.question: 趁机撤退还是找机会反击？

segment.title: 消散
segment.narration: 林夏在巷口汽雾中融入黑暗，把星核藏进假底仓。陈默从阴影里递来帽子，两人的背影被霓虹切割，黎明前他们消失在城市骨架里，星核成了仅存的筹码。
segment.image: Lin Xia and Chen Mo slipping into foggy alley; medium long shot, silhouettes, neon blur, low-key lighting

segment.title: 夺枪
segment.narration: 林夏一个翻转，夺过渡鸦的长狙，一枪打碎了天台的静谧。渡鸦倒地，咳出一口黑血，城市的警报像潮水般涌来。陈默牺牲挡下一发，林夏抱着妹妹般的绝望与胜利混合。
segment.image: Lin Xia wrestles a long rifle from Raven; dynamic close action, rain streaks, high contrast lighting

segment.title: 转身
segment.narration: 林夏突然把枪放回桌上，表情像收回的刀刃。她选择不以命换命，转身钻入车流，夜色把她吞没。
segment.image: Lin Xia turning away from a tense scuffle; medium shot, rain blur, backlight creating silhouette

segment.title: 硬碰硬
segment.narration: 林夏把手伸直让渡鸦检查，但眼神像冰。她赌上沉默与信任，赌一赌对方有没有兴趣深入刨根问底。
segment.image: Lin Xia offering her sleeve to Raven for inspection; close-up faces, rain on skin, stark neon highlights

node.question: 检查时发现异常数据怎么办？

segment.title: 曝光
segment.narration: 渡鸦的手在假芯片上停住，真正的星核滑出，投影立刻跳出实验名单与受害人画面。天穹的罪行在高空被点亮，顾衡的脸映在窗上，城市开始觉醒。代价是沉重：渡鸦开枪，陈默负伤，但星核发出的光比雨更刺眼。

dialogue.speaker: 顾衡
dialogue.text: 你们以为这样就能改变？

segment.image: Star Core projection exploding into data holograms; rooftop wide shot, Gu Heng's silhouette in window, intense backlight

segment.title: 协议
segment.narration: 渡鸦发现异常但收起怀疑，以沉默交换：林夏交出部分数据日志，作为放行条件。林小雨被允许离开，但星核仍被封锁一角，正义被延期成烟。

dialogue.speaker: 林夏
dialogue.text: 你欠我的不是账，是时间。

segment.image: Raven and Lin Xia leaning over a digital readout; medium close, rain streaks, muted palette

twist.label: 悔棋·闭嘴换命
twist.hint: 放弃揭露，换取妹妹安全

segment.title: 沉默的保护
segment.narration: 林夏在渡鸦的赤红目镜里看到妹妹的名字，她选择沉默，把核心的关键段落删去，用假证书换来林小雨的离去。夜依旧下着雨，良心被湿透。
segment.image: Lin Xia lowering her head while Raven watches; close-up, wet hair, neon reflection, low-key light

twist.label: 悔棋·揭穿自己
twist.hint: 主动暴露假货制造不同结局

segment.title: 暴露
segment.narration: 林夏忽然把假货甩到地上，露出真正的星核。此举震惊所有人，也把渡鸦逼到了边缘：选择射杀还是停手？

dialogue.speaker: 林夏
dialogue.text: 你们想要真相？那就拿去。

segment.image: Lin Xia throwing aside a fake; wide shot, Raven startled, neon flash, rain splatter

segment.title: 诱敌
segment.narration: 林夏故意手抖，假芯片掉落在边缘，像个诱饵。渡鸦的身形像乌鸦收拢，拉近到危险距离。
segment.image: Lin Xia feigning a drop of sleeve-wrapped object; Raven leaning forward, close medium shot, rain and neon glints

node.question: 渡鸦近身，林夏如何突围？

segment.title: 声光陷阱
segment.narration: 林夏按下隐蔽的楼顶控制键，警报与雾幕同时启动。渡鸦被短暂致盲，城市的高灯把他们裹进白茫。
segment.image: Rooftop alarm and fog machines activate; Lin Xia pressing a panel, Chen Mo rushing, wide action shot, harsh strobe light

node.question: 趁乱逃走还是抢走渡鸦武器？

segment.title: 带走
segment.narration: 混乱中，林夏把星核收进相机包，陈默挡在他们前面。两人消失在暴雨与雾气里。代价：渡鸦未被制止，顾衡随后启动更严苛监管，但星核安全带来了继续斗争的希望。
segment.image: Lin Xia slipping a blue data core into a camera bag; mid shot, fog and rain, Chen Mo covering, dramatic backlight

segment.title: 夺枪
segment.narration: 陈默抄起一把子弹，林夏硬生生从渡鸦手中抢下狙击。交火撕裂夜色，天台上血迹和雨交融。胜利换来沉重账单：友人受伤，城市的监控更近一步。
segment.image: Chen Mo and Lin Xia wrestling for a sniper rifle; dynamic close combat, rain splatter, harsh highlights

twist.label: 悔棋·引爆后悔
twist.hint: 启动陷阱同时后知后觉

segment.title: 代价
segment.narration: 触发机关后，林夏看到远处监控灯光转向一处幼稚的监护楼。她意识到陷阱连带暴露了附近无辜区域，后悔填满胸口。
segment.image: Lin Xia watching surveillance lights pivot toward a child-care block; medium shot, guilt in face, cold blue lighting

outcomes.label: 以身作饵
outcomes.hint: 把自己交给渡鸦换妹妹机会

segment.title: 交换
segment.narration: 林夏故意让渡鸦抓住自己，声音像被割断。她用身体做筹码，赌一赌对方的冷酷里是否藏着一丝交换的逻辑。
segment.image: Lin Xia allowing Raven to grab her arm; medium shot, dramatic rain, close distance between faces, neon rim

node.question: 渡鸦要证明诚意，林夏提出什么条件？

segment.title: 交换证据
segment.narration: 渡鸦把林小雨带来遇险地，按协议留下了穹顶一段内部通讯作为担保。林夏获释，得到了一条钩住顾衡的一线证据。代价是她的信任与时间，夜色里他们分道扬镳。
segment.image: Raven presenting a small data shard; Lin Xia and Lin Xiaoyu reunited, wide medium shot, solemn neon light

segment.title: 立放
segment.narration: 渡鸦冷冷点头，一句话未说就把林小雨推回林夏怀里，然后消失在雨帘里。林夏抱着妹妹，发现自己换来的是沉默而非同盟。城市的胜利仍未到来，但妹妹活着。
segment.image: Lin Xia clutching Lin Xiaoyu as Raven retreats into rain; close emotional shot, soft neon backlight

segment.title: 陷阱
segment.narration: 渡鸦假意同意，但在放人瞬间用磁扣锁住林夏，真相是她成为新的实验样本。林小雨哭喊的声音被夜雨吞没，林夏被带上了更冷的车。
segment.image: Raven snapping a magnetic restraint on Lin Xia; medium close, shocked faces, rain and neon contrast

segment.title: 被动
segment.narration: 渡鸦没有被戏耍，他手一抖，天台的监控灯像蜂群一样朝林夏扑来。她被逼进绝路，交易变成猎场。
segment.image: Raven standing tall as surveillance lights sweep in; wide rooftop shot, tense silhouette, cold white light

outcomes.label: 直接引爆争端
outcomes.hint: 当众揭露，强迫对方做选择

segment.title: 公开挑衅
segment.narration: 林夏把真星核摔在桌上，数据投影立刻飞溅成蓝色星雨。38层的交易瞬间变成审判庭，城市的眼睛被点亮。
segment.image: Lin Xia slamming a glowing core onto a rooftop table; wide shot, holographic data burst, Gu Heng visible in distant window, dramatic spotlight

node.question: 公开揭发后，顾衡会如何反应？

outcomes.label: 祭出渡鸦
outcomes.hint: 顾衡放手杀手解决问题

segment.title: 放出杀手
segment.narration: 顾衡在高楼之上冷笑，命令像冷弹下达：渡鸦打开狙击瞄镜，城市的天穹为他铺路，子弹随之而来。
segment.image: Gu Heng issuing an order from a high-rise window; Raven adjusting a sniper scope on rooftop, long lens, stark top light

node.question: 面对狙击，林夏选择？

segment.title: 挡弹
segment.narration: 陈默把林小雨推向安全出口，林夏踩着栏杆站成靶子。子弹贯穿了她的风衣，血在霓虹下像花瓣散开。她笑了，像在告诉妹妹：去活下去，别为我哭泣。
segment.image: Lin Xia standing on rooftop railing as bullets strike; dramatic long shot, rain, neon reflections, high-contrast lighting

segment.title: 冲锋
segment.narration: 林夏冲向狙击手，和渡鸦在狭窄的天台上搏斗。最终两人都倒下，天台像被撕裂的画布。胜利短暂而残酷：渡鸦死了，但星核摔碎了，真相散成碎片。
segment.image: Lin Xia and Raven engaged in brutal close combat under neon rain; tight action frames, splintered lighting

twist.label: 悔棋·顾衡退位
twist.hint: 顾衡突然收手另有图谋

segment.title: 指令撤回
segment.narration: 就在子弹将发的一刻，顾衡转身取消命令，露出一个更加冷酷的笑容：他要的并非立即杀戮，而是把星核和林夏都抓回实验室，游戏进入更深一层。

dialogue.speaker: 顾衡
dialogue.text: 留着她，我有更好的用途。

segment.image: Gu Heng turning away from window, smirk visible; Raven lowering the rifle momentarily, cold interior light

segment.title: 无视
segment.narration: 顾衡面不改色，仿佛雨只是景深的一部分。他冷冷下令保护记录，而不是瞬间清场，选择用法律与金钱碾压真相的路线。
segment.image: Gu Heng composed in his office, watching the rooftop through glass; distant rooftop figures small, soft office lighting

node.question: 等待法律还是夺路而逃？

segment.title: 公审
segment.narration: 林夏把星核交给一位地下记者，交由法律程序公审。庭审成为新港的裂缝，顾衡表面镇定但内心动摇。尽管财团运作仍顽强，天穹受限，真相被写进判决书，城市开始缓慢变化。
segment.image: Courtroom scene with projection of Star Core data; medium wide shot, Lin Xia watching, Gu Heng in suit, soft courtroom light

segment.title: 远走
segment.narration: 林夏把星核的一部分分散写入数个备份，带着妹妹逃向海外暗港。真相碎片散落在黑市与媒体间，虽然没有一夜改朝换代，但穹顶的统治被永久动摇。
segment.image: Lin Xia and Lin Xiaoyu boarding a dinghy under rain; long shot, distant city skyline, muted dawn light

twist.label: 悔棋·记者出卖
twist.hint: 媒体成了新的交易对象

segment.title: 背叛
segment.narration: 地下记者在金钱与安全的诱惑下出卖了数据的去向，星核的一部分被回收，林夏被迫带着残缺的真相逃亡。城市的裂缝被拼补，斗争继续但代价更深。
segment.image: A furtive hand exchanging a data shard with a suited handler; close shot, rain-slicked hands, low warm light

segment.title: 干预
segment.narration: 就在公开对峙达到顶点时，天穹自动介入：街道广播、无人机灯阵和数据库纷纷响应，城市像被埋伏的棋盘般被重新排布。每个人都被迫接受新的规则。
segment.image: Drones and city displays activating over the rooftop; wide shot, digital overlays bathing figures, cold blue-white light

segment.title: 复制疑云
segment.narration: 当事态推进，林夏在心里一震：真正的星核或许早被复制分散，手中的只是能引爆一场风暴的影像副本。每一步赌注都变成了一场关于真假与代价的博弈。
segment.image: A split image of the blue core duplicated; close-up, mirrored reflections of Lin Xia holding data core, cold neon fragments

segment.title: 炸裂之夜
segment.narration: 林夏按下隐藏信号，天台投影骤变，警报与激光编织出恐怖的烟火。
segment.image: Rooftop wide action. Characters: Lin Xia sprinting, Chen Mo providing cover with revolver, Raven firing from high angle; chaotic composition, strobe-like alarms, dramatic backlight and rain.

node.question: 天台信号引爆后，下一步怎么做？

segment.title: 声东击西
segment.narration: 投影与警报吞没了霓虹，天台成了迷离的火海。林夏趁乱拔出星核，目光像锋利的冰。
segment.image: Characters Lin Xia and Chen Mo on rooftop amid alarm holograms; medium-wide shot; staccato neon backlight and smoke; Lin Xia clutching blue chip, Chen Mo covering exit

node.question: 趁乱撤离还是引开追兵？

segment.title: 撤离
segment.narration: 林夏抱紧星核，带着林小雨向天台楼梯冲下。雾与激光像刀，脚步在金属阶上回响。
segment.image: Lin Xia and Lin Xiaoyu running down fire-illuminated stairs; close to medium shot; motion blur; harsh red and blue lighting

node.question: 最终抉择

segment.title: 安全屋
segment.narration: 他们藏进旧港区的一间阁楼，雨声像窒息的被子。星核被包裹在布里，林夏每夜查看，像守候着一枚能颠覆城市的心脏。
segment.image: Lin Xia, Lin Xiaoyu, Chen Mo in dim attic; close shot; warm lamp light contrasts cold rain outside; intimate framing

segment.title: 结盟
segment.narration: 林夏带着星核去找旧日联系人，换来一夜的庇护与沉重的人情账。代价是未来某晚他们得回报──或被拿去偿还。

dialogue.speaker: 林夏
dialogue.text: 我要你们的人脉和一条后路。

segment.image: Lin Xia meeting shadowy ally in neon diner; medium shot; wet reflections, cigarette smoke; tense table composition

segment.title: 回望天台
segment.narration: 林夏忽然听见天台上熟悉的枪声，她紧握星核的手抖了。有人在叫她的名字，像是召回她的责任——或者陷阱。
segment.image: Lin Xia pausing on stairs, looking back to rooftop; wide shot; silhouetted figures against alarm holograms, cold light

segment.title: 诱敌
segment.narration: 林夏掏出泛蓝光的接口，留下一串虚假信号，身体朝对面楼顶冲出，像一颗被迫投出的子弹。
segment.image: Lin Xia sprinting across rooftop gap toward opposite building; long shot; stark moonlight and siren flares, dramatic motion

node.question: 单独突围还是设圈套？

segment.title: 一人出击
segment.narration: 林夏独自穿过雨夜的天台群，爆破与追光像猎犬。最终她被渡鸦狙击手一枪撂倒，星核滚入暗影，城市没能在她掌心重生。
segment.image: Raven taking a cold shot at Lin Xia mid-leap; extreme long shot; stark silhouette against neon, rain streaks illuminated

segment.title: 反制
segment.narration: 林夏早已留下假信号，渡鸦被引入布满电磁陷阱的暗巷。陈默从侧翼出现，制服了突袭者，星核在雨中被再次夺回。
segment.image: Chen Mo emerging to subdue Raven in narrow alley; medium shot; backlit rain, neon reflections on wet asphalt, dynamic framing

segment.title: 牺牲代价
segment.narration: 在最后一刻，林夏取消了圈套，决定用自己换取林小雨的撤离。陈默只能眼睁睁看她进入枪口。
segment.image: Lin Xia standing defiantly while others retreat; mid shot; harsh spotlight, rain halo, tense composition

segment.title: 白喙归来
segment.narration: 天台上风停了，一只黑影落下。渡鸦的帽影遮住了霓虹，远处狙击镜红光一闪，像死亡的承诺。
segment.image: Raven landing on rooftop edge above Lin Xia; long shot; stark contrast, single red dot of scope, misted neon

segment.title: 全城曝光
segment.narration: 林夏把星核插入天台的投影节点，瞬间人群与高楼都成了屏幕，天穹实验的影像像暴雨般倾泻下来。
segment.image: Lin Xia inserting blue chip into rooftop holo node; wide aerial shot of city screens igniting; cool blue light flooding buildings

node.question: 继续放大还是控制播出？

outcomes.label: 放大播出
outcomes.hint: 将所有门锁与视窗同步

segment.title: 全面播出
segment.narration: 天穹的影像侵占了每家每户，市民的屏幕被迫见证被隐瞒的实验。街头的喧嚣像要将夜晚撕裂。
segment.image: Citywide screens showing experimental footage; panorama shot; millions of tiny lightboxes, rain reflecting on glass facades

node.question: 带着真相离开还是守在天台？

segment.title: 有证据
segment.narration: 真相已播出，街头燃起抗议。林夏带着星核在混乱中消失，她知道这只是第一胜利，真正的审判还在路上。
segment.image: Lin Xia slipping into alley with chip while protests erupt; medium shot; torchlight and umbrella silhouettes, dynamic crowd

segment.title: 守望
segment.narration: 林夏站在天台中心，镜头紧盯她的脸。她被抓捕成了公开审判的证人，牺牲换来全城对穹顶的质问与愤怒。
segment.image: Lin Xia surrounded by riot police on rooftop; close-up and wide intercut; flashing lights, rain on face, solemn posture

segment.title: 片段丢失
segment.narration: 在撤离前，林夏发现影像里一段关键试验被黑影篡改。星核的另一份备份未见，她必须回头取证。
segment.image: Lin Xia viewing corrupted footage on rooftop node; close shot; glitch artifacts across hologram, cold blue light

segment.title: 有限曝光
segment.narration: 林夏挑选了最能震撼市民的片段，屏幕上的画面像刀，割开顾衡的权威，却没有露出所有秘密网络。
segment.image: Lin Xia controlling projection feed; medium close; selective footage playing on nearby skyscraper, focused lighting

node.question: 公开幕后资料还是保留筹码？

segment.title: 全部曝光
segment.narration: 林夏最终决定释放全部资料，穹顶的黑暗网络被撕开。顾衡被推上新闻头条，审判开始，但代价是穹顶对反抗的全面清算。
segment.image: Mass media frenzy as full files are released; wide shot; cameras, drones, flash, stark high-contrast lighting

segment.title: 以证换命
segment.narration: 林夏保留关键备份，向外提供有限证据换取林小雨的安全与撤离通道。真相被分期公开，权力与道德的天平未彻底倾覆。

dialogue.speaker: 林夏
dialogue.text: 我永远不会把小雨当赌注。

segment.image: Shadowed exchange between Lin Xia and intermediary under rain; medium shot; guarded posture, dim neon, exchanged data packet

twist.label: 悔棋：备用上传失败
twist.hint: 技术意外导致数据中断

segment.title: 上传中断
segment.narration: 在最后关键一刻，天穹反制，备用上载失败。林夏不得不承认，穹顶的防火墙比她想象的更深。
segment.image: Hologram flicker and failed upload screen; close-up; glitching interface, pale light, tense hands

segment.title: 学生直播
segment.narration: 林小雨在市区广场直播自己的追查记录，画面和情绪像火种一样蔓延，给了林夏一个不可预期的公众后盾。

dialogue.speaker: 林小雨
dialogue.text: 大家看见了吗？这是他们的真面目。

segment.image: Lin Xiaoyu live-streaming in crowded square; medium shot; handheld camera feel, warm crowd light, screen reflections

segment.title: 面对董事长
segment.narration: 天台上影像还未完全收束，顾衡已从高楼滑门缓步而来，金袖扣在雨中闪冷光，他像走向审判台。

dialogue.speaker: 顾衡
dialogue.text: 你把我当成了剧终的反派。

segment.image: Gu Heng approaching on rooftop, Lin Xia opposite; medium-long shot; silver hair and white suit contrasted with dark coat, rain-lit

node.question: 直接质问还是要挟谈判？

segment.title: 直面质问
segment.narration: 林夏把星核举在顾衡面前，影像在他眼前闪烁。顾衡的微笑像刀刃，屋顶的风把秘密吹得更寒冷。
segment.image: Close confrontation between Lin Xia and Gu Heng on rooftop; close shot; rain streaks, eyes locked, tense composition

node.question: 宽恕能换取退出吗？

segment.title: 交易
segment.narration: 顾衡在言辞间转移责任，低调撤换高层以换取软着陆。林夏得到保证，但城市的体制只换了皮，真正的罪行潜入地下。
segment.image: Negotiation scene on rooftop with two figures shaking hands; medium shot; rain-slick shoulders, uneasy smiles

segment.title: 剥皮
segment.narration: 林夏把完整证据投到天穹网络，顾衡的脸色瞬间崩裂。安保迟到，公众早已看到，董事长成了囚徒般的存在，权力瓦解的声音在雨中逐渐高涨。
segment.image: Gu Heng exposed on rooftop as broadcast displays his crimes; wide shot; spotlight on him, surrounding darkness, raining confetti of data

segment.title: 奸计
segment.narration: 顾衡假意承认罪行，引导媒体镜头到设好的阵地，瞬间调动保安将林小雨挟持为人质，局势骤然翻转。
segment.image: Gu Heng speaking to cameras while hidden guards seize crowd; medium shot; staged lighting, shadowy figures behind him

segment.title: 要挟
segment.narration: 林夏把星核举高，像举起一把刀，条件简单明了：停止人体实验并安全放人。顾衡的笑容开始有裂缝。

dialogue.speaker: 林夏
dialogue.text: 交换：实验证据换小雨自由。

segment.image: Lin Xia holding chip threateningly toward Gu Heng; medium close; rain and neon, chip glowing, tense negative space

node.question: 接受交易还是设圈套？

segment.title: 交换
segment.narration: 顾衡答应暂时停止项目并释放林小雨，作为交换林夏必须交出星核。林小雨拥抱姐姐，城市在黎明前喘息，但真正的正义被押在未来的赌注里。
segment.image: Lin Xia and Lin Xiaoyu embracing as Gu Heng steps back; medium shot; soft dawn light breaking through rain, guarded relief

segment.title: 假芯片
segment.narration: 林夏递出了伪装的星核，实则早把真芯片藏在城中信任的人手里。顾衡得手的一刻，陈默与一群觉醒者发动清算，董事长在黎明前失势。
segment.image: Staged handover of fake chip while others move in; wide cinematic shot; rain-swept rooftop, coordinated silhouettes, dynamic lighting

segment.title: 第三方
segment.narration: 就在交换前，穹顶内侧势力突袭，真芯片从林夏手中被不明势力夺走，交换瞬间失效，所有人都成了棋子。
segment.image: Unseen assailant snatching chip mid-exchange; close shot; blurred motion, hands, rain droplets frozen midair

segment.title: 狙击干扰
segment.narration: 渡鸦的狙击镜忽然瞄向楼下人群，城市瞬间被他那把长枪的影子笼罩。谈判桌上，枪口静静地改变了规则。
segment.image: Raven's scope glinting from distant rooftop; long shot; narrow red dot, blurred cityscape, rain-smeared lens

segment.title: AI反噬
segment.narration: 就在所有人做出决定的一刻，天穹开始回溯并改写投影，屏幕上的影像出现了未知注记，整座城市的网络像被看不见的手重新洗牌。
segment.image: Sky-wide data lines bending as AI interference ripples; wide aerial shot; cold digital aurora over city, glitching holograms

segment.title: 相机快门
segment.narration: 林小雨悄无声息冲上天台，用相机挡住渡鸦的狙击镜，她把星核塞回林夏手中。
segment.image: Rooftop tense insert. Characters: Lin Xiaoyu in yellow raincoat stepping between Lin Xia and Raven, camera raised, medium close; Lin Xia recoils, Raven's red goggle reflected in lens; high contrast backlight.

segment.title: 自毁序列
segment.narration: 星核自行启动毁灭程序，天台被蓝光吞噬。信息消失，可代价是无法复原的牺牲。
segment.image: Rooftop finale. Characters: Lin Xia clutching empty palm where chip vaporizes, Gu Heng visible on distant vid-link smirking; wide shot, surreal blue flare enveloping scene, backlit silhouettes.

segment.title: 狙击者的抉择
segment.narration: 渡鸦在最后一刻收枪，转身消失于雨中，留下了一个装着复制数据的空盒子。
segment.image: Rooftop aftermath. Characters: Raven walking away into rain, cloak flaring, small box glinting in foreground; Chen Mo and Lin Xia stunned in midground; low-key lighting, long lens compression.

segment.title: 窗前下令
segment.narration: 顾衡亲自降临天台，优雅却致命的动作切断了所有逃路，城市的命运被他单手判定。
segment.image: Rooftop confrontation. Characters: Gu Heng stepping onto rooftop, white suit stained by rain, close-medium shot; Lin Xia and Chen Mo preparing to defend, dramatic top lighting from office windows.
